title: Forming a new band with Josh Johnson after Julia
summary: After Julia left for the Cuban Room he assembled a band with Josh Johnson and Clayborn Graves out on 40.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So what year would you think you and Julia left Milton's? And you told me earlier that Julia got a single at the Cuban Room and then what did you do?
Well, I were off for a while when she went to the Cuban Room. I wasn't doing anything.
Well, you couldn't do that for very long because you had to get some money.
Well, you know, I had to get a bunch together because Julia and I had been together so long.
So you formed a band again.
But you don't remember who was on the band, or do you? Was Herman on it, or Booker, or Woody, Josh.
Yeah, Josh Johnson on the piano.
That's right, yeah. Josh was on it. And I think Frog was playing with us, [Claymon] Grave, a saxophone player was playing with us.
You keep going out to 40 every time we're trying to find a--
Yeah. I was on 40 back in those days.
